meta.description: Federal baseline rules applied before any state-specific resolution. These rules represent minimum federal standards, statutory deadlines, and escalation hooks that apply regardless of state.

federal_statutes.label: Violence Against Women Act
baseline_rules: Victim has right to petition under VAWA self-petition within 2 years of divorce
VAWA protections apply regardless of immigration status
Federal funding requires state compliance with full faith and credit for protection orders

federal_statutes.label: Fair Housing Act
baseline_rules: HUD complaint must be filed within 1 year of discriminatory act
Prohibits discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, familial status, disability

federal_statutes.label: Employee Retirement Income Security Act
baseline_rules: 180 days for internal appeal of claim denial
External review available under ACA within 4 months of internal denial

federal_statutes.label: Fair Labor Standards Act
baseline_rules: 2-year statute of limitations for non-willful violations
3-year statute of limitations for willful violations
Federal minimum wage applies as floor

federal_statutes.label: Indian Child Welfare Act
baseline_rules: Notice to tribe required by registered mail for any child custody proceeding involving Indian child
Active efforts required before removal (higher standard than reasonable efforts)
Tribal court has exclusive jurisdiction for children domiciled on reservation
Placement preferences: extended family, tribal foster home, Indian foster home, institution approved by tribe

federal_statutes.label: Fair Debt Collection Practices Act
baseline_rules: 30 days to dispute debt in writing after initial notice
1-year statute of limitations for FDCPA lawsuit
Collector must cease collection on disputed debt until verified

federal_statutes.label: Elder Justice Act
baseline_rules: Encourages mandatory reporting of elder abuse
CMS requires investigation within 2-10 days depending on severity for nursing home complaints

federal_statutes.label: Adoption and Safe Families Act
baseline_rules: Permanency hearing required within 12 months of removal
TPR petition required if child in care 15 of most recent 22 months

federal_statutes.label: Affordable Care Act
baseline_rules: External review right for all non-grandfathered health plans
No annual or lifetime dollar limits on essential health benefits
Preventive services must be covered without cost-sharing

federal_deadlines.action: File internal appeal of claim denial
File external review after internal denial

federal_escalation_hooks.federal_agency: DOJ Civil Rights Division / Office on Violence Against Women
federal_escalation_hooks.trigger: State fails to enforce protection orders or VAWA provisions

federal_escalation_hooks.federal_agency: HUD Office of Fair Housing and Equal Opportunity
federal_escalation_hooks.trigger: Housing discrimination based on protected class

federal_escalation_hooks.federal_agency: DOL Employee Benefits Security Administration / HHS
federal_escalation_hooks.trigger: ERISA plan denial without proper process or ACA violation
Federal minimum wage or overtime violation

federal_escalation_hooks.federal_agency: HHS Administration for Children and Families
federal_escalation_hooks.trigger: State fails to meet Title IV-E requirements or ICWA compliance
Systematic failure to investigate or prevent elder abuse

federal_escalation_hooks.federal_agency: CMS / HHS Office of Inspector General
federal_escalation_hooks.trigger: Nursing home or guardianship abuse with federal funding nexus
Violation of Flores Settlement or constitutional due process in family separation
